description.en: Write an idea down the moment it comes: a timeline with #tags, pins, search and an archive.
description.zh: 想到就记：一条想法时间线，支持 #标签、置顶、搜索和归档。

instructions: One row per idea. text: the idea as the person wrote it, plain text (no Markdown), line breaks kept, 1 to 4000 characters, no spaces around it; never translate or reword it. tags: the #tags of the text, without the '#', folded (NFKC, then lower case: '#Garden' and '＃ＧＡＲＤＥＮ' are both 'garden'), each once, in the order they first appear in the text. A tag is '#' or '＃' and 1 to 30 letters, digits, '_' or '-' in any script, ending where those end (in Chinese, put a space or a punctuation mark after it); a longer run is no tag, and a '#' inside a web address starts none. Write tags whenever you write text. The page finds and counts tags in the text itself, so to tag an idea, put the #tag into its text. pinned: kept at the top of the timeline. archived: put away (done or given up), kept, and out of the timeline until brought back. A new idea has pinned and archived false. Archiving sets pinned false too: an archived idea is never pinned, and one brought back (archived false) stays unpinned. The timeline shows pinned ideas first, then the newest first; an idea's time is when it was created. A space holds at most 5000 ideas, archived ones included; the page turns a new one down after that.
